steps.intro: Welcome to the Splendor tutorial. This guide will quickly teach you the goal, market, gems, reserving, buying, nobles, and endgame.
steps.goal: Your goal is to gain prestige by buying development cards and earning nobles. Endgame triggers when a player ends their turn with at least 15 points.
steps.nobles: This is the nobles panel. At end of turn, if your purchased card discounts satisfy a noble, you gain it automatically. If multiple qualify, you choose one.
steps.actions: This is the action panel. It reminds you what to do now and explains extra interaction entry points such as reserving from the deck top.
steps.market: This is the central market. Each tier has a deck and open cards. You can buy open cards directly or reserve the top card of a deck.
steps.bank: This is the gem supply. Click gem icons to pick gems. Normally you must take 3 different colors; if a pile has at least 4 gems, you may take 2 of that color instead.
steps.bankConfirm: This is the gem confirmation area. Selected colors, taking two of the same color, taking different colors, and clearing the selection are all confirmed here.
steps.takeGemsAction: Now try it yourself: complete one legal gem-taking action in the bank. The tutorial will advance automatically after success.
steps.playerStatus: This is the player status panel. It shows each player's total gems, gem colors, discounts, and nobles. Your own reserved and purchased cards can also be expanded here.
steps.reserveAction: Next, note how reserving works: you may reserve an open card or take the top card of a deck; if gold is still available, reserving also gives you 1 gold token.
steps.buyAction: When you buy a development card, the game first applies your permanent discounts, then automatically calculates the gems and gold you still need to pay. The payment hint in the market tells you whether you can afford the card right now.
steps.nobleTiming: Nobles are not gained by clicking them. The game checks noble requirements only at the end of your turn using your purchased-card discounts; if you qualify for multiple nobles, only then do you choose one.
steps.tokenLimit: Remember the gem limit: you may temporarily go above 10 gems during your action, but you must discard down to 10 before the turn can finish.
steps.endgameDetail: Endgame starts when a player finishes a turn with at least 15 points, but the game does not stop immediately; every player must finish the same number of turns. If players tie on points, the one with fewer purchased development cards wins; if still tied, they share victory.
steps.finish: You now know the full base-game loop: take gems, reserve cards, buy cards, gain nobles at turn end, and resolve endgame after someone reaches 15 points. You are ready to start a real game of Splendor.
